What the driver found and committed on this branch (commit 30ff9f1, on top of your 207a48f — keep it, do not revert or rewrite it):

The liveness plumbing was never wired into a real run: nothing constructed ActivityRegistry or LivenessProbe. _cmd_run now builds one ActivityRegistry passed to build_session_runner(activity=) and ReviewDeps(activity=, liveness=config.liveness); _GroupExecution installs a LivenessProbe via heartbeat.add_tick_hook. The R7 notes in `streaming.py` and `sessions.py` module docstrings say explicitly that no round or work wall-clock limit exists and that liveness is a separate, evidence-only concern (R3).
